def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Extend each diagonal run of at least two matching non-background cells
    # outward in both directions until the edge or another colored cell.
    seeds = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg]
    for r, c in seeds:
        color = grid[r][c]
        for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
            rr, cc = r + dr, c + dc
            if not (0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == color):
                continue
            # The pair (r,c)-(r+dr,c+dc) determines this diagonal.
            for sr, sc in ((-dr, -dc), (dr, dc)):
                ar, ac = (r, c) if (sr, sc) == (-dr, -dc) else (rr, cc)
                nr, nc = ar + sr, ac + sc
                while 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and grid[nr][nc] == bg:
                    out[nr][nc] = color
                    nr += sr
                    nc += sc
    return out
